title: Maya Book Awards — debut authors and literary organisations
brief:
Project: Maya Book Awards

The Maya Book Awards celebrate debut fiction. We want around 150 submissions for this year's award. Find authors of debut literary fiction published in the last two years by UK independent publishers. Also find literary organisations such as reading charities and writers' centres for partnerships to promote the award. Do not approach authors published by the big five publishing houses. Capture author name, debut title, publisher, publication date, and agent contact. Use publisher catalogues, literary magazines and prize longlists. Tone: warm and encouraging. Reference their debut by title, but avoid reviewing or critiquing the book.
notes: 'big five' is a recognised industry term but should be confirmed (which imprints count).
